name: wemd-electron
description: WeMD - 更优雅的 Markdown 公众号排版工具
author: WeMD Team

scripts.test: node ../../scripts/sync-version.mjs && rimraf dist && tsc && node --test dist/**/*.test.js
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:web && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 -c electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.build:win: npm run build:web && npm run build && electron-builder --win -c electron-builder.json --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:web && npm run build && electron-builder --linux -c electron-builder.json --publish never
